# kloPIT

> Free open-source PIT-38 tax calculator for Polish investors using foreign brokers. Runs entirely in the browser — data never leaves the device.

kloPIT calculates Polish PIT-38 and PIT/ZG values from foreign-broker trades, dividends, NBP exchange rates and FIFO cost basis. Imported data stays locally in IndexedDB and is not sent to any server. AGPL-3.0, no signup, no tracking.

## Capabilities

- Import CSV from Interactive Brokers Activity Statements (trades, dividends, withholding tax, corporate actions).
- Import PDF from IBI Capital for ESPP and RSU grants with per-grant FIFO lots.
- Import CSV from Charles Schwab.
- Manual entry for trades, dividends and foreign withholding tax for any other broker.
- Capital gains via FIFO per ISIN, with lot-level isolation for ESPP grants.
- NBP Table A average exchange rates from the business day preceding each transaction or dividend.
- Foreign dividend withholding credit capped per dividend at the lower of 19% and the bilateral tax-treaty rate.
- PIT-38 Section C (proceeds and costs), Section D (tax base and 19% tax), Section G (foreign dividends), Section H (total tax due).
- PIT/ZG per-country breakdown using ISIN country mapping.
- Loss carryforward over 5 years with the 50% annual cap.
- Carry-in positions across tax years.
- Symbol-to-country override table for treaty rate selection.

## Disclaimer

kloPIT is not an official tax administration tool and does not constitute legal or tax advice. Verify all results before filing your declaration.
